case: Who wrote book of hebrews in the bible?

Sometime after the first century, Luke the Evangelist, Apollos, or his teacher Priscilla were also proposed as authors of the Book of Hebrews.
According to Adolf von Harnack and some recent scholars, Priscilla wrote the Book of Hebrews.
According to Tertullian, Barnabas wrote the Book of Hebrews.
According to Martin Luther, Apollos wrote the Book of Hebrews.
